**Argentina** won the 2022 FIFA World Cup.

{

WITH t AS (
  SELECT id FROM world_cup.world_cup.tournaments WHERE tournament_year = 2022
),
ko AS (
  SELECT m.id, m.stage, m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id, m.winner_team_id,
         m.home_goals, m.away_goals,
         ht.team_name AS home_name, at.team_name AS away_name,
         hs.possession_pct AS home_poss, aws.possession_pct AS away_poss
  FROM world_cup.world_cup.matches m
  JOIN t ON m.tournament_id = t.id
  JOIN world_cup.world_cup.teams ht ON ht.id = m.home_team_id
  JOIN world_cup.world_cup.teams at ON at.id = m.away_team_id
  JOIN world_cup.world_cup.match_team_statistics hs ON hs.match_id = m.id AND hs.team_id = m.home_team_id
  JOIN world_cup.world_cup.match_team_statistics aws ON aws.match_id = m.id AND aws.team_id = m.away_team_id
  WHERE m.stage <> 'group'
)
SELECT stage, home_name, away_name, home_goals, away_goals, home_poss, away_poss,
  CASE WHEN winner_team_id = home_team_id THEN home_name
       WHEN winner_team_id = away_team_id THEN away_name
       ELSE 'draw/pen' END AS winner,
  CASE WHEN home_poss > away_poss THEN home_name
       WHEN away_poss > home_poss THEN away_name
       ELSE 'tie' END AS more_possession
FROM ko
ORDER BY stage, home_name;
",
  "rationale": "I'm pulling every 2022 knockout match with each side's possession and the actual winner so I can compare whether the team with more ball possession tended to win."
}
